name: meta-plugin
description: An agent-team skill that interviews you to design a role-based agent team for a task and runs it to produce the work product, a doc-system skill for generating PRD/SPEC/CLAUDE.md, a system-explain skill for first-principles system-design explanations, a ship-slice skill for atomically shipping a vertical slice (status flip in milestone.md, handoff pointer advance, teammate shutdown, one commit), and a vault-save utility for stashing Claude responses into an Obsidian vault
